QuestInfo.name: Well Met, Mercedes
QuestInfo.0: Mercedes greeted you warmly. Finally, someone acting normal! Enjoy your time with her.
QuestInfo.1: Okay... something isn't right. Why can't she remember any of the details? And why in the world would she call you Shade? It would seem... this isn't Mercedes at all.
QuestInfo.2: So, it was all an illusion. Why would she do such a thing? Such a terrible disappointment...

0.msg: The curse of the Black Mage wasn't lifted at all, then. It seems more like everyone here is stuck in an unwaking dream.
